```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../setup.R")
PRE_PET_CA <- read.csv("../Input/PET&PRE_Region_30y.csv")
PRE_PET_US <- read.csv(us_outputs("1.5_PET&PRE_State_30y.csv"))
PRE_PET <- rbind(PRE_PET_US, PRE_PET_CA)
```

## read all data

```{r all data}
# read & stack
N2OIEF <- list.files("../Output", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  # iterate over each file and bind rows as we go
  map_dfr(~ {
    file    <- .x
    raw_tbl <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # 1. harmonise key columns --------------------------------------------------
   clean_tbl <- raw_tbl %>%
   rename_with(~ "Region", any_of(c("Province", "ProvinceID", "Region"))) %>% 
   rename_with(~ "Crop",   any_of(c("Crop", "CropID")))

    # 2. add metadata -----------------------------------------------------------
    clean_tbl %>% 
      mutate(
        File      = basename(file),
        Country   = str_detect(File, "_Canada")   %>% if_else("Canada", "USA"),
        Pathway   = case_when(
          str_detect(File, "FSN")            ~ "Direct – FSN",
          str_detect(File, "Irrigation")     ~ "Direct – Irrigation",
          str_detect(File, "Volatilization") ~ "Indirect – Volatilisation",
          str_detect(File, "Leaching")       ~ "Indirect – Leaching",
          TRUE                               ~ "Unknown"
        )
      ) %>% 
      # 3. keep only what we need (Region, Crop, N2O.IEF + metadata)
      select(Region, Crop, Tot.Fert, Tot.N2O, N2O.IEF, Country, Pathway, File)
  }) %>%
  mutate(N2O.IEF = na_if(N2O.IEF,0)) %>%
  mutate(IsDirect = str_starts(Pathway, "Direct"))


#Join IEF and PRE, PET data
N2OIEF <- N2OIEF %>%
  left_join(PRE_PET, by = c("Region" = "REGION")) 


# Replace Canada's region name
N2OIEF <- N2OIEF %>%
   mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "QC" ~ "QUEBEC",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "ON" ~ "ONTARIO",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "MB" ~ "MANITOBA",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "SK" ~ "SASKATCHEWAN",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "AB" ~ "ALBERTA",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "BC" ~ "BRITISH COLUMBIA",
      Country == "Canada" & Region == "AT" ~ "ATLANTIC",         # special case
      TRUE                                   ~ Region            # keep other values
    ))


```


## Plot 

x and y are the precipitation and potential evapotranspiration in growing season. 

```{r Fig 1}
#Create table for direct emissions and regardless of crop. 
IEF_Region <- N2OIEF %>%
  filter(!is.na(Tot.Fert), Tot.Fert != 0) %>%
  group_by(Region, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    Sum_Fert       = sum(Tot.Fert, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sum_N2O        = sum(Tot.N2O,  na.rm = TRUE),
    GROW_PRE_wavg  = first(GROW_PRE_wavg),
    GROW_PET_wavg  = first(GROW_PET_wavg),
    IsDirect       = first(IsDirect),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Sum_IEF = Sum_N2O/Sum_Fert) %>%
  filter(IsDirect == TRUE)



#draw the plot
scale_factor <- 150

# 1. prepare the pie‐data ------------------------------------------------------
pie_data <- IEF_Region %>%
  # keep only FSN + Irrigation
  filter(Pathway %in% c("Direct – FSN", "Direct – Irrigation")) %>%
  # make each region one row, FSN/Irrigation as columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Pathway,
    values_from = Sum_IEF,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # compute total and radius & jitter coordinates
  mutate(
    total_IEF = `Direct – FSN` + `Direct – Irrigation`,
    # scale_factor chosen so pies are legible; you can tweak this
    radius    = sqrt(total_IEF / pi) * scale_factor,
    # jitter x and y by 1% of each range
    x = jitter(GROW_PET_wavg, amount = 0.01 * diff(range(GROW_PET_wavg))),
    y = jitter(GROW_PRE_wavg, amount = 0.01 * diff(range(GROW_PRE_wavg)))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Direct_FSN        = sum(`Direct – FSN`,        na.rm = TRUE),
    Direct_Irrigation = sum(`Direct – Irrigation`, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_IEF         = Direct_FSN + Direct_Irrigation,
    x                 = mean(x),
    y                 = mean(y),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    radius = sqrt(total_IEF / pi) *scale_factor
    )


# 2. draw the scatter‐pie ------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot() +
  # base: pies at (x, y) with radius 'radius'
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = pie_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, r = radius),
    cols = c("Direct_FSN", "Direct_Irrigation"),
    show.legend = TRUE,
    colour = NA # no border
  ) +
  # custom fill colours for clarity
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Direct_FSN"        = "#E34A33",
      "Direct_Irrigation" = "#3182BD"
    ),
    name = "Pathway"
  ) +
    # 2. Invisible points to trigger a size legend
  geom_point(
    data = pie_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, size = total_IEF),
    colour = NA,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name   = "Total IEF\n(kg N₂O-N / kg N)", 
    #range  = c(7.9788, 11.28379, 15.95769, 25.2313, 35.68248),                # adjust so legend circles match pie scale
    range  = c(8,36),                # adjust so legend circles match pie scale
    breaks = c(0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1),   # example key values
    labels = comma_format(accuracy = 0.001)
  ) +
 geom_text_repel(
    data         = pie_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = Region),
    size         = 2,          # adjust text size
    box.padding  = 0.2,        # space between text and pie
    point.padding    = 0.4,
    segment.size     = 0.25,
    segment.curvature= -0.1,
    segment.ncp      = 5,
    force            = 2.0,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  # axis labels & title
  labs(
    x = "Weighted mean PET (GROW_PET_wavg)",
    y = "Weighted mean Precip (GROW_PRE_wavg)",
    title    = "Direct N₂O implied emission factors by Region",
    subtitle = "Pie area ∝ total Direct IEF; slices = FSN vs. Irrigation"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +            # equal scales on x & y
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Fig2_IEF_piechart.pdf",
  plot     = p,
  # 2-column width = 180 mm → 180/25.4 ≈ 7.09 in
  width    = 7.09,  
  height   = 8.27,  # e.g. max 2-col height ~210 mm → 210/25.4 ≈ 8.27 in
  units    = "in",
  device   = cairo_pdf  # embeds fonts cleanly
)

```




## Plot distribution of crop's N2OIEF

```{r distribution plot}

#  prepare data: drop missing emission-factors
df <- N2OIEF %>% 
  filter(!is.na(N2O.IEF))%>%
  mutate(LogIEF = log10(N2O.IEF)) %>%
  mutate(Crop = factor(Crop, levels = rev(sort(unique(Crop)))))

#Plot ridge plot
library(ggridges)
library(forcats)

p <- df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = LogIEF, y = Crop, fill = Pathway)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous("Log10 implied N2O emission factor") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    axis.title     = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text      = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.text     = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.text    = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title   = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position= "bottom"
  )


# after building your ggplot object `p`:
ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Fig1_IEF_ridgelines.pdf",
  plot     = p,
  # 2-column width = 180 mm → 180/25.4 ≈ 7.09 in
  width    = 7.09,  
  height   = 8.27,  # e.g. max 2-col height ~210 mm → 210/25.4 ≈ 8.27 in
  units    = "in",
  device   = cairo_pdf  # embeds fonts cleanly
)


```
